install_steps: brew tap datadog-labs/pack && brew install datadog-labs/pack/pup
Authenticate: pup auth login (opens browser for OAuth2)
note: Also available as pre-built binary from GitHub Releases: https://github.com/DataDog/pup/releases. Build from source: cargo build --release. Pup auto-detects AI agents and returns structured JSON. Run 'pup agent schema' for self-discoverable command list.
